events.name: Next Stop: Rinascita
events.summary: O Rover guided by the tides, you have banished the shadows of war in Jinzhou and crossed the boundaries of time on Mt.
events.detail: O Rover guided by the tides, you have banished the shadows of war in Jinzhou and crossed the boundaries of time on Mt. Firmament. When you stood upon the secluded shores, did you hear the gospel carried on the tempest winds, echoing across the stormy sea? Did you glimpse the unparalleled splendor that lies within the fabled land of Echoes? Now, steel your heart and embark on a journey into the unknown, brave the storm, and carve a path to Rinascita.

art.credit: © Kuro Games, via the Wuthering Waves Wiki on Fandom

events.name: Tales of the Isles
events.summary: After braving the perilous sea mists and tumultuous waves, you've finally arrived in Rinascita, the Land of Echoes.
events.detail: After braving the perilous sea mists and tumultuous waves, you've finally arrived in Rinascita, the Land of Echoes. Radiant lights stretch across the horizon, while cheerful melodies echo through the bays and blooms. The Carnevale is around the corner. May your journey be one to remember. Complete event quests to earn rewards.

events.name: Into the Land of Paradox
events.summary: Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe have joined forces to establish a foothold on the Dimmr Plains, launching a joint scientific expedition into this long-isol
events.detail: Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe have joined forces to establish a foothold on the Dimmr Plains, launching a joint scientific expedition into this long-isolated realm. Objectives include collecting environmental data, recovering ancient plant samples and Exostrider components, and remediating environmental damage caused by Void Storms. The fruits of this operation will effectively advance ecological research and habitat restoration in Lahai-Roi. You recieve a message from I.R.I.S., inviting you to join the inaugural expedition...

events.name: Next Stop: Mengzhou
events.summary: O Seeker of the road ahead, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores.
events.detail: O Seeker of the road ahead, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores. You've braved tempests, heard the dual nature of Ragunna's faith, and tasted the glory in the arenas of Septimont. Adventuring through the City Set in Amber, you faced deep space in mysterious Lahai-Roi, meeting the Void with courage. Now the road ahead has again revealed itself. Let us return to Huanglong, and journey on to Mengzhou.
